content:
Apple Store is now selling cases and other accessories for the new iPhone 18 Pro. The new phone will officially go on sale in one week, with pre-orders starting tomorrow.

The new accessories include cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, as well as accessories for other products.

Another piece of good news is that the iPhone 18 Pro case is compatible with the iPhone 17 Pro. If you want to buy a new colour or new style of case for your new phone but have no intention of upgrading, this design is very practical.

The product lineup includes Apple's US$49 silicone case, a redesigned clear case with MagSafe, and a relaunched US$59 TechWoven woven case.

Apple is also simultaneously selling an updated FineWoven wallet in a new colour, along with the Crossbody Strap — also priced at US$59 — which now comes in more style options.

The most eye-catching new product is Apple's brand-new Wrist Strap, priced at US$29. It can be clipped onto compatible Apple cases and is also suitable for the AirPods Pro 2 and AirPods Pro 3.

This 15.4-inch strap is made from 100% recycled polyester yarn and has built-in flexible magnets to help it sit neatly and snugly around your wrist.

The Wrist Strap is available in black, taupe, olive green, light blue, magenta and wine red.

The product is compatible with TechWoven, silicone and clear cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, as well as a range of cases designed for the iPhone 17 series.

Get the most out of your Apple products.
